notes: DONE: 3063 unique URLs, 31/31 days (09-30=115, 10-10=83, 10-20=115; min 41 on 10-18), 3 requests total, ~3 s. Route: robots.txt 200 and permissive (only /arama.html and /haber/hava-durumu/ disallowed, no Crawl-delay) and its Sitemap line names /sitemaps/news.xml -> 200, a sitemapindex of per-month urlsets /sitemaps/news-YYYY-MM.xml (news-2016-07 .. news-2026-10). Only the two files news-2026-09.xml (200, 771,913 bytes, 3129 urls) and news-2026-10.xml (200, 629,992 bytes, 2567 urls) are needed; both are flat <urlset> with <loc><![CDATA[...]]></loc> and <lastmod>, no recursion, no paging. Listed date = date part of <lastmod> (Europe/Istanbul, +03:00), which is the publish instant, not an edit stamp: on 23 sampled articles the page JSON-LD datePublished matched the lastmod within the same minute (e.g. lastmod 2026-10-20T23:52:16+03:00 == datePublished 2026-10-20T23:51:00+03:00). Excluded the robots-disallowed /haber/hava-durumu/ weather pages and anything outside /haber/*.html. Sample re-fetch of 23 articles across the three target days: all 200, article text 3.0k-7.0k chars after tag stripping, page date always the listed day, so the 1500-char and +-1 day conditions hold. Month files are derived from the window instead of trusting the index's stale lastmods. The site serves everything under www.trthaber.com; no AMP or archive pages were needed, and /sitemap.xml itself only lists pages/tags/schedules, not articles.
